agencies.label: MyCURE (civic)
agencies.how: File the same issue on the MyCURE app (it replaced MyGHMC). Paste the ticket number here so both ledgers match.
agencies.sourceLabel: GHMC: civic complaints are also filed on MyCURE (retrieved 22 Aug 2026)

agencies.label: HMWSSB 155313 / 14420
agencies.how: Call 155313 (water) or 14420 (sewerage), or use the board’s published channels, then paste their ticket number.

agencies.label: TGSPDCL 1912
agencies.how: Call 1912 or use the TGSPDCL consumer portal, then paste their complaint number.

agencies.label: CPGRAMS
agencies.how: If the city ticket is dead, file on CPGRAMS and paste the registration number. Use as escalation, not the first stop.
agencies.sourceLabel: Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System
